aggressive_definition: No aggressive prostate cancer endpoint was defined or analyzed.
reason: The abstract reports a case-control comparison involving prostate cancer overall and benign prostatic hyperplasia or general controls. It provides no stage, grade, metastatic, lethal, or other aggressive endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Of Japan side, as far as dietary part of the result is concerned, vitamin A might be risk reducing factor for prostatic cancer when prostatic cancer is compared to benign prostatic hyperplasia or general control.
estimate_classifications.reason: The vitamin A association is for prostate cancer overall, not an aggressive subtype.
